description: Gets one club's season: every game in it, pre-season, regular season and post-season, each with the club's result and its record after it, and every season held for the club. Takes the id find_teams or list_teams gives, and a season slug such as 2026 or 2025-2026; without one, the current season. Answers "what is their record" and "how did their season go".

season.description: The season's slug (2026, 2025-2026); the current season when none is given.

name: get_team_season

build.description: The running build's id, so a page's tag turns over on deploy.

current.description: Whether this is the club's current season, the one its next game is in.

currentSeason.description: The club's current season's slug, which its season page names by the bare address.

ingesting.description: Whether ingestion is switched on; a league switched off still answers, with scores that no longer move.

sport.description: The sport's code (SOCCER), which decides a screen's words: a soccer board shows matches, not games.

parts.description: The regular season, then the post-season, then the pre-season: only those with a game.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

outcome.description: How the game went for this side, as Outcome judges it; null until Final.

segments.description: The line score in the scoreboard's segment order; a null value is a segment not played.

order.description: Cricket: the innings' place in the match, 1 for the side that batted first; null in every other sport.

overs.description: Cricket: the overs the innings lasted, in overs-and-balls notation (19.4 is nineteen overs and four balls); null in every other sport.

value.description: The points scored, or null when the segment was not played; never zero for that.

wickets.description: Cricket: the wickets down in the innings; null in every other sport.

stats.description: The scoreboard's stats the provider reported, by key.

total.description: The provider's total, or null when no result carries one.

declared.description: How a final ended as the provider declared it, for a sport whose totals can't say (cricket): who won and by what, a tie, or no result. Null in every other sport and before the end.

margin.description: What the win was by, when the provider said; null on every other verdict, and on a win it gave no margin for.

innings.description: The winners batted once and still made more than the other side's two innings: "by an innings and 12 runs".

revised.description: The target was revised for lost time, by the Duckworth–Lewis–Stern method.

unit.description: Runs when the side batting first won, wickets when the side batting last did.

winner.description: The side that won; set on Won only.

abbreviation.description: Three letters, for where even the short name will not fit.

shortName.description: The name for a narrow cell, such as "Guardians".

slug.description: The club's address within its league, from the stored name, as Slug.

outcome.description: How the game went for this side, as Outcome judges it; null until Final.

segments.description: The line score in the scoreboard's segment order; a null value is a segment not played.

order.description: Cricket: the innings' place in the match, 1 for the side that batted first; null in every other sport.

overs.description: Cricket: the overs the innings lasted, in overs-and-balls notation (19.4 is nineteen overs and four balls); null in every other sport.

value.description: The points scored, or null when the segment was not played; never zero for that.

wickets.description: Cricket: the wickets down in the innings; null in every other sport.

stats.description: The scoreboard's stats the provider reported, by key.

total.description: The provider's total, or null when no result carries one.

locationTbd.description: The provider has named no ground for it yet, so its location is to be decided ("Location TBD") and Venue is null: not its home club's ground. A page writes no structured event for it, since an event's location is required.

position.description: Where a live game is; null in every other state.

break.description: The provider's pause between segments, which overrides the segment's reading on a board.

clock.description: The provider's timer text; always null when Source is Inferred.

half.description: Which half of the inning, on a scoreboard that PlaysHalves.

segment.description: The segment in play, in the scoreboard's keys; null when nothing places the game.

venue.description: The venue's name, where one is stored.

home.description: Whether the club is the home side.

key.description: The game's permalink key, the last segment of its page's address.

recordAfter.description: The club's record after this game; regular-season finals only.

result.description: The club's result as a record column (W, L, D, OTL); null until the game is final.

timeProvisional.description: The provider hasn't confirmed the start time, so it may move.

week.description: The week of the regular season the game is played in, in a league that plays a game a week; null elsewhere.

postSeasonRecord.description: The post-season's own record, or null when the season has no post-season game for the club.

record.description: The regular-season record in the league's columns; pre-season and post-season games never count in it.

season.description: This season's slug: 2026, or 2025-2026 for a league whose season spans two years.

seasons.description: Every season held for the club, newest first.

aliases.description: The other addresses the team answers to within its league (ClubAddresses), which move a reader to Slug; empty for most.

hashtags.description: Its hashtags in English, each led by #: those that go with the first of its English accounts that has any (SocialHashtags); empty when none does. Always a list.

home.description: Where it plays at home: its home venue's city, state and country, and where on the map; null without a venue. The home page's search finds a club by it (a city, a state, a country, or anywhere near a city), as a calendar's events already name the venue's address.

city.description: The venue's city, as stored: Miami Gardens.

country.description: Its country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 as stored: US, GB.

latitude.description: Where it is, in degrees; null when the venue has no position.

longitude.description: Where it is, in degrees; null when the venue has no position.

state.description: Its state or province, as stored (FL); null where the country has none stored.

kind.description: club, solo (one athlete, by that athlete's name) or national.

logoIsFallback.description: Whether LogoUrl fell back to the league mark, which may indicate a missing team mark.

logoUrl.description: The team's logo URL; always present, since resolution falls back to the league mark.

name.description: The name as the reader's culture shows it: an operator's name for that culture or English, else the stored one.

slug.description: The team's address within its league, from the stored name, so a renamed team keeps its links.

standing.description: Its place in the league's table, where the provider publishes one; null for every league without a table pull.

computedAt.description: When the provider last computed the table (UTC).

form.description: The last five results, oldest first, as W, D and L; null early in a season.

group.description: The table the team plays in, for a competition of several: Group A; null for a league of one table.

netRunRate.description: Cricket: the net run rate the table breaks ties on, as the provider computed it (0.744); null in every other sport.

noResult.description: Cricket: the games washed out with no result, which a cricket table counts beside wins and losses.

points.description: Points as the provider counts them, so a deduction is included.

rank.description: The table position, by the league's own tie-breaks.

zone.description: The zone the position falls in, in the provider's words: Relegation - Championship; null mid-table.
The league's day zone, the IANA id a page states a start time in before it knows the visitor's own.
